offering.name: API Development & Management
offering.tagline: Turn your systems and data into governed, reusable APIs.
offering.summary: design, build, and management of secure, documented APIs that expose the organization's systems and data for internal and partner use
capabilities: RESTful API design following clear standards
API gateway, authentication, and rate limiting
typical_requirements: Expose internal systems and data through secure APIs
Govern access with authentication and rate limiting
integrations: the systems of record being exposed
the API gateway and monitoring tools
differentiators: Standards-based, versioned APIs partners can build on
Governance and monitoring built into the gateway
offering.pricing_model: Fixed price by workstream, invoiced on milestones
success_metrics: systems exposed through secure, documented APIs

snippets.understanding: You want to unlock the data and functions trapped in your systems — for internal teams or partners — through secure, well-governed APIs rather than one-off point integrations.
snippets.solution: We will design standards-based REST APIs, front them with a gateway that handles authentication, rate limiting, and monitoring, and publish interactive, versioned documentation with self-service developer onboarding.

product_line.name: Integration & APIs
product_line.summary: Connecting the systems an organization already runs.
